items.text: Journey ↗ opens a new page: swap a sentence, Add now and ▶ play a line, right there.
Flag a card on your phone: Surasura reads it as Known, Swap or Ignore at the next sync.
Delete one of Surasura's cards in Anki and it asks why: Known, Ignore, Parsing mistake, Bad card.
Swap keeps your card: the same card gets a better sentence, and its reviews are kept.
A card you add from the journey comes first among your new cards.
Known · Ignore: the Blacklist joins your Ignore list once; Your words has both tabs.
Tidy: unstudied cards past 1.5× your limit are deleted, a copy kept, with Undo.
One study order for Connect and Junban, and Cards for every new word.
A book paired with its audiobook gives cards from its chapters, with audio.
Gentler on the machine: the window first, then one heavy job at a time on a small PC.
Starting a review in Anki pauses card making, so your review card is never redrawn.
Backfill fills a card's missing furigana and pitch; Connect's cards always get both.
